notes.title: 🚀 The Launch Update! 🚀
notes.content:
Today marks the [b]0th anniversary[/b] of the release of [i]Cosmo's Delivery and Logistics[/i]! For those of you who played the demo, a summary of all the new content:

[h2]Full Release Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multiple planets to explore
[*] More dastardly cheaters to face!
[*] Improved player deck-building mechanics
[*] A grand finale at New Reno Station, featuring an all-cheater 6-player tournament table
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix: Fixed persistent crashing!
notes.content:
Hallelujah! They say it's a poor craftsman who blames his tools, but I blame Unity!

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed random memory-corruption crashes on many user computers caused by the Dispose() method of ProfilingScope[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: v0.9.1 Improved Objectives and Poker Rules Fixes
notes.content:
Small update! This is a hotfix to address the following issues:
[list]
[*] Lack of clarity for finding tables 2 and 3 on Buzz's Gazz
[*] Fixed several bugs in the poker rules engine, namely aces not contributing to low straights, and the "under the gun" player not being first to act each hand
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.0 -- AI Cheaters
notes.content:
The tables have turned! Just in time for the release of the first demo, Cosmo is dismayed to find himself no longer the only cheater in town...

[h2]Introducing:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]"Short Line" Larry[/b] is a no-nonsense, efficiency-oriented sort of fellow. When he plays poker, he only needs 4 cards to form a Straight.
[*] [b]Frankie "The Ace"[/b] is a friendly, generous person who plays poker to socialize. The Ace is her favorite card, so she doesn't see the harm in always making sure to draw one!
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved deckbuilding -- players can now decline cards from both secrets and level-ups
[*] More secrets, and many secrets now give Experience or Credits
[*] Improved naming for community cards
[*] Fixed a critical bug where double-clicking with a self-targeted cheat broke the game
[*] Many visual fixes
[/list]
